scope: Tracked maintained source/patch files and extensionless hooks; immutable/vendor/build exclusions below

exclusions.docs/vendor: Pinned third-party/shared inputs, not house-style migration
exclusions.docs/evidence: Immutable historical snapshots and generated outputs, not current implementation
exclusions.build: Private generated sources, upstream trees and outputs; consumed generated code still needs review
exclusions.non-source: Narrative, manifests and other assets are outside this source census; coverage.json owns documentation inventory

limits: Static subprocess hints are review leads, not defects or execution evidence.
Top-level and generated CLI behavior is not inferred by importing code.
No complete source audit, minimum-runtime, native or release claim.
